listing.name: Diablo / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Native Diablo PlayStation recompilation from Alexbeav’s PSXRecomp project.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac tools and setup kit
steps.instruction: Choose the official v0.1.4 ZIP for your Intel or Apple silicon Mac and unpack it into a writable folder. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer on PATH. The bundled game and BIOS generators require macOS 15 or newer.

steps.title: Supply your matching disc and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own European Diablo disc (SLES-01156) with its single data track intact. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together when using CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Build and add the player on Mac
steps.instruction: Run Diablo_Recompiled from the unpacked folder and follow Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Diablo_Recompiled as the program and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Portcove has not verified Mac setup, gameplay or save compatibility for this kit.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc image, BIOS, saves, settings and overlay captures before replacing the kit. Keep the player with the folder that built it.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching single-track CHD for Diablo Europe SLES-01156 and legally obtained retail SCPH-5552 BIOS. OpenBIOS is not an accepted substitute for this release. Portcove uses its registered Python/build toolchain for managed preparation and skips the setup launcher when playing. Generation, runtime, lifecycle and gameplay are untested. Preserve the title GPL-3.0-only, framework PolyForm Noncommercial and UI MIT notices; no rights to retail game data or generated retail content are inferred. Linux x86-64 uses the pinned managed build toolchain; the packaged setup host requires GLIBC 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26 and OpenGL. Generated-game minimum-host compatibility and Linux runtime behavior remain untested.
